center_north.source: Default field runway center plus twice the 80 m circuit radius and twice the 12 m runway width; derived by the source-bound Stik pilot route factors.

center_east.source: Copied from the normalized default field runway center_east.

radius.source: Maximum of 0.8 times the 100 m runway length and 4.0 times its 12 m width, from the source-bound Stik pilot.

base_agl.source: Current Stik pilot base circuit altitude; passed the calm and gentle-practice 120 s matrix.

slot_agl_step.source: Current Stik pilot altitude spacing between airborne admission slots; passed the 1–3 aircraft matrix.

duration_s.source: Six pilot-matrix scenarios, each completing 28,800 physics ticks at 240 Hz.

min_agl.source: Minimum local terrain clearance across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

max_agl.source: Maximum local terrain clearance across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

min_tas.source: Minimum TAS across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

max_tas.source: Maximum TAS across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

max_radial_error.source: Maximum absolute radial error across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

min_player_separation.source: Minimum player-to-companion center separation across the six companion pilot matrix scenarios.

min_pair_separation.source: Minimum companion-to-companion center separation in the tested multi-aircraft scenarios.
